title: City Scape Dream - Feeling of being chased
content: Hi guys I never post stuff on reddit but I can not get this off my mind. For the past few years, every few weeks or so, I have this reoccurring dream where I am in a a large city with a ton of skyscrapers and is definitely futuristic - it almost looks like the city in the most recent season of West World. I have attached an AI generated image which was the closest I could get to what I remember. I am always in different states of lucidity when in the dream - with most times being aware that I am dreaming. Besides being in the city I am almost always chased by what I have presumed to be Nazis. They are not dressed in Nazi uniform- more so in men in black type suits but I always deem them to be Nazis - I do not know why. Has anyone experienced anything similar. I saw a few cityscape posts that I resonated with but nothing involving being chased and knowing you are being chased/in a dream but are still scared?
